Operational prescription: Dr.GRPO is NOT a universally-correct length-bias remedy; it is regime-specific with sign set by the underlying correlation of length with reward. 5-fold cross-validation (n=12 anchors restricted to n_steps>=5) shows the full-interaction model (log10(N) + arch_moe + interaction) lifts CV SSE by 332 units over the arch-only model and adds 99 units OVER the null, while the log10(N)-alone model makes predictions WORSE than the null (improvement=-99). The interaction model is the right predictive scaling, not log10(N) by itself.
